title: Preserve one, many and optional association endpoints
preconditions: Composition fixture connects left/record to right/record with tail zero-or-many and head only-one, pinned to the declared association.

steps.action: Render both detail and overview modes and inspect marker endpoints.
steps.expected_result: Both modes preserve start/tail and end/head markers for optional-many owner and one destination.
The incident relationship retains exact endpoints, tail/head multiplicity and source pin.

steps.action: View an association whose destination cardinality is unknown.
steps.expected_result: Unknown is shown explicitly rather than represented as one or many.
